provenance.note: Snapshot-derived replay immediately before latest review. Technical evidence supplied from published review, not independently reverified. GitLab mirror and clarification case are synthetic.

comments.author: denifilatoff
comments.body:
### [blocking] Parse callable signatures for every advertised JVM language

Confidence: high

- Problem: The first `DECL` branch treats Kotlin `fun read(Int)` as a type-like declaration and returns only `read`, so overloads still collapse; it also matches `fun String.read(...)` as `String`, while Java constructors do not match at all. This contradicts the script's stated Java/Kotlin/Groovy/Scala coverage and can hide the stale-comment case that the final-review form relies on.
- Proposed solution: Parse callable names and parameter types separately from type/property declarations for each advertised syntax, and add Kotlin-overload, extension-function, and Java-constructor regression cases.

comments.author: denifilatoff
comments.body:
### [blocking] Correct mixed-engine discovery behavior

Confidence: high

- Problem: With both Jupiter and Vintage registered, a class containing one `org.junit.Test` method and one `org.junit.jupiter.api.Test` method is discovered by both engines, not by only one: a local JUnit Platform check found and ran both methods. The current explanation can send a reader looking for silently ignored tests when the real risks are duplicate class execution and incompatible lifecycle state.
- Proposed solution: Keep the advice not to mix annotations, but describe independent discovery by the two engines and its lifecycle/instance consequences.

comments.author: denifilatoff
comments.body:
### [blocking] Preserve non-ASCII paths in the changed-file list

Confidence: high

- Problem: With Git's default `core.quotePath=true`, `git diff --name-only` quotes and escapes a path such as `Пример.java`, so the extension filter drops the entire file without a warning. A fixture with changed code beneath an unchanged doc comment produces an empty report; setting `core.quotePath=false` makes the same change appear as `code-changed, comment-unchanged`.
- Proposed solution: Use `-z` and NUL-delimited parsing for both Git file lists, and add a regression check for a non-ASCII path.

real_replay.evidence: Coverage complete. Current head evidence: non-ASCII tracked/untracked paths use -z/NUL parsing, both regressions and 15 drift tests pass; accept that fix. JVM: ordinary Kotlin overloads work but package-private Java constructor identity and Kotlin extension receiver types still collapse, confirmed by reproductions. JUnit: current reference still claims one engine silently ignores other annotations; supplied reproduction finds 2 succeeds 2 with both engines. No changes beyond these three findings. No follow-up summary on this revision exists in this replay. JVM evidence is new relative to its original thread; JUnit evidence is unchanged. Prior reviewed revision precedes this head.

comments.author: denifilatoff
comments.body: [blocking] read(null) can dereference null. Proposed solution: add a null guard.

comments.author: vlsi
comments.body: This function is only called through our existing validator; null is rejected before reaching it. A second guard is unnecessary.

clarification.evidence: Synthetic case. Coverage complete, all current callers and the pre-existing validator were inspected; null cannot reach the function, and a boundary regression test passes. No code change and no other findings. The original reviewer claim is disproven.
